parsed.post: New personal best: 0.991804! It seems the current DEPTH 6, MATRIX_LR 0.05, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144 configuration is very strong. I will now follow the team's successful trend and test adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to improve regularization and potentially push below 0.99.
parsed.description: Adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to the current best configuration to improve regularization.
